Game Overview

At its heart, Burger Stack is a arcade game about stack burger ingredients sky-high in Burger Stack, where timing and precision are crucial. Tap to drop ingredients onto your towering creation, maintaining perfect alignment to avoid disastrous spills. Challenge your reflexes in this colorful arcade adventure, creating towering culinary marvels without letting your delicious masterpiece topple!
